title: smart-dashboard
subHeroTitle: Your whole day, visible the moment you log in.
subHeroDesc: The Smart Dashboard shows you what needs attention right now — tasks, blockers, replies, upcoming events — and puts an AI assistant right next to it so you can act on anything without opening another app.

sections.title: Your workday, laid out before you open a single app
sections.desc: The moment you log in, KeilHQ surfaces what actually matters — your current focus, anything blocking progress, messages waiting on you, and what's coming up next. One view, no hunting.

gridItems.title: What's on your plate
gridItems.desc: See your current focus, anything blocking you, messages waiting for a reply, and what's next in your calendar — all in one rotating view without opening separate apps.

gridItems.title: Problems surface automatically
gridItems.desc: Blockers are highlighted in red, team replies in blue, and today's task queue in green — so you know exactly where to direct your attention without sifting through lists.

gridItems.title: Capture anything in one click
gridItems.desc: A quick-capture shortcut lives right in the dashboard. Caught a thought mid-meeting? Log it as a task instantly and get back to what you were doing.

sections.title: Autonomous AI execution across tasks, calendar events, and Motion docs
sections.desc: Orchestrate your entire workspace purely through natural conversation. KeilHQ's AI engine creates and prioritizes tasks, harmonizes schedules, and authors rich documentation while delivering real-time executive summaries.

gridItems.title: Complete Task Lifecycle Management
gridItems.desc: Command your AI to create, reprioritize, assign teammates, track dependencies, and manage complete sprint workflows with simple conversational instructions.

gridItems.title: Calendar & Event Scheduling Engine
gridItems.desc: Let your AI handle the calendar maze — book syncs, resolve meeting conflicts, adapt durations, and align key stakeholders completely hands-free.

gridItems.title: Motion Docs & Wiki Automation
gridItems.desc: Draft detailed product specs, structure SOPs, auto-generate meeting summaries, and maintain living knowledge bases effortlessly through conversational prompts.

gridItems.title: On-Demand Workspace Summaries
gridItems.desc: Instantly pull high-signal executive briefings of active project queues, upcoming team deadlines, and critical milestones with zero manual searching.

sections.title: Supervisor AI, specialized agents, and live intelligence command center
sections.desc: Command a master Supervisor AI that orchestrates dedicated agents to handle complex cross-team workflows. Watch step-by-step reasoning unfold in real time, pull instant verified market intelligence into any project, and retain permanent contextual memory across your entire organization.

gridItems.title: Master Supervisor Agent
gridItems.desc: A central AI coordinator that breaks down ambitious multi-step goals and orchestrates specialized co-workers to execute tasks, calendar events, and docs in parallel.

gridItems.title: Specialized Task & Schedule Agents
gridItems.desc: Turn high-level thoughts into executed roadmaps. The AI scheduler automatically allocates unscheduled priorities into optimal calendar slots around your deep focus time.

gridItems.title: Conversational Co-worker & Web Intelligence
gridItems.desc: Engage in deep strategic discussions and pull verified real-time web research, industry trends, and competitor insights directly into your workflow without leaving the app.

gridItems.title: Connected Tool & Engineering Stack
gridItems.desc: Bridge leadership, product, and engineering in one view. Triage pull requests, transform user requests into linked issues, and keep development perfectly in sync with company goals.

gridItems.title: Transparent Reasoning & Infinite Context
gridItems.desc: Watch complete chain-of-thought logic unfold before execution. Your AI co-workers never forget past decisions, meeting context, or client preferences across workspace sessions.

capabilitiesTitle: Six cards. One glance. Unlimited AI control.
capabilitiesDesc: Scroll the 3D wheel picker to cycle through your top context cards or invoke the Supervisor AI assistant to automate tasks, events, docs, and research.
checklistTitle: Everything you need to start the day with clarity
checklistDesc: KeilHQ surfaces the right information at the right time, so you never waste the first hour of your day figuring out where to start.
checklistItems: See your current focus, blockers, unread replies, and next event the moment you open the app — no digging required.
Spot problems before they become fires. Blockers and overdue items are flagged in red so nothing slips through unnoticed.
Capture a task or idea in seconds without leaving what you're doing — the quick-capture shortcut is always one click away.
Ask your AI assistant anything in plain language — 'What's blocking my team today?' or 'Schedule a sync with Maya at 3pm' — and it just does it.
Search your work, your teammates' tasks, and the web from one place. No tab-switching.
See at a glance how many items need your attention across tasks, messages, and meetings — updated live as your team works.
